# WebJSX - Minimal JSX Library for Web Components

WebJSX is a lightweight library (2 core functions) for building web applications using JSX syntax and Web Components. It provides virtual DOM diffing without the overhead of a full framework.

## Core Concepts

WebJSX has only two main functions:
- `createElement`: Creates virtual DOM elements (called automatically by JSX)
- `applyDiff`: Efficiently updates real DOM by comparing virtual nodes

## Installation

```bash
npm install webjsx
```

For routing:
```bash
npm install webjsx-router
```

## TypeScript Configuration

tsconfig.json:
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "jsxImportSource": "webjsx",
    "target": "ES2020",
    "module": "ES2020",
    "moduleResolution": "node",
    "strict": true
  }
}
```

## Basic Usage

### Simple JSX Rendering

```jsx
import * as webjsx from "webjsx";

const vdom = (
  <div id="app">
    <h1>Hello WebJSX</h1>
    <p>Simple and fast</p>
  </div>
);

const container = document.getElementById("root");
webjsx.applyDiff(container, vdom);
```

### Creating Web Components

```jsx
import * as webjsx from "webjsx";

class TodoItem extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["text", "completed"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const text = this.getAttribute("text") || "";
    const completed = this.hasAttribute("completed");
    
    const vdom = (
      <div class={`todo-item ${completed ? "completed" : ""}`}>
        <input 
          type="checkbox" 
          checked={completed}
          onchange={() => this.toggleComplete()}
        />
        <span>{text}</span>
        <button onclick={() => this.remove()}>Delete</button>
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }

  toggleComplete() {
    if (this.hasAttribute("completed")) {
      this.removeAttribute("completed");
    } else {
      this.setAttribute("completed", "");
    }
  }
}

customElements.define("todo-item", TodoItem);
```

### State Management in Components

```jsx
class Counter extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.count = 0;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  increment() {
    this.count++;
    this.render();
  }

  decrement() {
    this.count--;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const vdom = (
      <div class="counter">
        <button onclick={() => this.decrement()}>-</button>
        <span>{this.count}</span>
        <button onclick={() => this.increment()}>+</button>
      </div>
    );
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("my-counter", Counter);
```

### Using Fragments

Fragments group elements without extra DOM nodes:

```jsx
const vdom = (
  <>
    <h1>Title</h1>
    <p>Paragraph 1</p>
    <p>Paragraph 2</p>
  </>
);
```

### Event Handling

```jsx
class SearchBox extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.query = "";
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  handleInput(e) {
    this.query = e.target.value;
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("search", { 
      detail: { query: this.query },
      bubbles: true 
    }));
  }

  handleSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    console.log("Searching for:", this.query);
  }

  render() {
    const vdom = (
      <form onsubmit={(e) => this.handleSubmit(e)}>
        <input 
          type="text"
          value={this.query}
          oninput={(e) => this.handleInput(e)}
          placeholder="Search..."
        />
        <button type="submit">Search</button>
      </form>
    );
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("search-box", SearchBox);
```

### Component Props and Attributes

```jsx
class UserCard extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["name", "avatar", "bio"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const name = this.getAttribute("name") || "Anonymous";
    const avatar = this.getAttribute("avatar") || "/default-avatar.png";
    const bio = this.getAttribute("bio") || "No bio available";

    const vdom = (
      <div class="user-card">
        <img src={avatar} alt={name} />
        <h3>{name}</h3>
        <p>{bio}</p>
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("user-card", UserCard);

// Usage:
const app = (
  <user-card 
    name="John Doe" 
    avatar="/john.jpg" 
    bio="Software developer"
  />
);
```

### Refs and Direct DOM Access

```jsx
class FileUploader extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.fileInputRef = { current: null };
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  handleButtonClick() {
    this.fileInputRef.current?.click();
  }

  handleFileChange(e) {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      console.log("Selected file:", file.name);
    }
  }

  render() {
    const vdom = (
      <div>
        <input 
          type="file"
          ref={this.fileInputRef}
          style="display: none"
          onchange={(e) => this.handleFileChange(e)}
        />
        <button onclick={() => this.handleButtonClick()}>
          Choose File
        </button>
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("file-uploader", FileUploader);
```

### Conditional Rendering

```jsx
class ConditionalExample extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.isLoggedIn = false;
    this.showDetails = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const vdom = (
      <div>
        {this.isLoggedIn ? (
          <div>
            <h2>Welcome back!</h2>
            <button onclick={() => this.isLoggedIn = false}>Logout</button>
            
            {this.showDetails && (
              <div class="details">
                <p>Here are your account details...</p>
              </div>
            )}
            
            <button onclick={() => {
              this.showDetails = !this.showDetails;
              this.render();
            }}>
              {this.showDetails ? "Hide" : "Show"} Details
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div>
            <h2>Please log in</h2>
            <button onclick={() => {
              this.isLoggedIn = true;
              this.render();
            }}>
              Login
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("conditional-example", ConditionalExample);
```

### List Rendering and Keys

```jsx
class TodoList extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.todos = [
      { id: 1, text: "Learn WebJSX", done: true },
      { id: 2, text: "Build an app", done: false },
      { id: 3, text: "Deploy to production", done: false }
    ];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  addTodo(text) {
    const newTodo = {
      id: Date.now(),
      text,
      done: false
    };
    this.todos.push(newTodo);
    this.render();
  }

  toggleTodo(id) {
    const todo = this.todos.find(t => t.id === id);
    if (todo) {
      todo.done = !todo.done;
      this.render();
    }
  }

  deleteTodo(id) {
    this.todos = this.todos.filter(t => t.id !== id);
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const vdom = (
      <div>
        <h2>Todo List</h2>
        <ul>
          {this.todos.map(todo => (
            <li key={todo.id} class={todo.done ? "done" : ""}>
              <input 
                type="checkbox"
                checked={todo.done}
                onchange={() => this.toggleTodo(todo.id)}
              />
              <span>{todo.text}</span>
              <button onclick={() => this.deleteTodo(todo.id)}>×</button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <form onsubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const input = e.target.elements.todoInput;
          if (input.value.trim()) {
            this.addTodo(input.value);
            input.value = "";
          }
        }}>
          <input name="todoInput" placeholder="Add todo..." />
          <button type="submit">Add</button>
        </form>
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("todo-list", TodoList);
```

### Async Data Loading

```jsx
class UserList extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.users = [];
    this.loading = true;
    this.error = null;
  }

  async connectedCallback() {
    await this.loadUsers();
  }

  async loadUsers() {
    this.loading = true;
    this.render();
    
    try {
      const response = await fetch("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users");
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch");
      this.users = await response.json();
      this.loading = false;
    } catch (err) {
      this.error = err.message;
      this.loading = false;
    }
    
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    let content;
    
    if (this.loading) {
      content = <div class="spinner">Loading...</div>;
    } else if (this.error) {
      content = (
        <div class="error">
          Error: {this.error}
          <button onclick={() => this.loadUsers()}>Retry</button>
        </div>
      );
    } else {
      content = (
        <ul>
          {this.users.map(user => (
            <li key={user.id}>
              <strong>{user.name}</strong> - {user.email}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      );
    }

    const vdom = (
      <div class="user-list">
        <h2>Users</h2>
        {content}
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("user-list", UserList);
```

### Forms and Controlled Inputs

```jsx
class ContactForm extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.formData = {
      name: "",
      email: "",
      message: ""
    };
    this.errors = {};
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  updateField(field, value) {
    this.formData[field] = value;
    this.validateField(field, value);
    this.render();
  }

  validateField(field, value) {
    delete this.errors[field];
    
    switch(field) {
      case "name":
        if (!value.trim()) {
          this.errors.name = "Name is required";
        }
        break;
      case "email":
        if (!value.includes("@")) {
          this.errors.email = "Invalid email";
        }
        break;
      case "message":
        if (value.length < 10) {
          this.errors.message = "Message too short";
        }
        break;
    }
  }

  handleSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    // Validate all fields
    Object.keys(this.formData).forEach(field => {
      this.validateField(field, this.formData[field]);
    });
    
    if (Object.keys(this.errors).length === 0) {
      console.log("Form submitted:", this.formData);
      // Reset form
      this.formData = { name: "", email: "", message: "" };
      this.render();
    } else {
      this.render();
    }
  }

  render() {
    const vdom = (
      <form onsubmit={(e) => this.handleSubmit(e)}>
        <div>
          <label>Name:</label>
          <input 
            type="text"
            value={this.formData.name}
            oninput={(e) => this.updateField("name", e.target.value)}
          />
          {this.errors.name && <span class="error">{this.errors.name}</span>}
        </div>
        
        <div>
          <label>Email:</label>
          <input 
            type="email"
            value={this.formData.email}
            oninput={(e) => this.updateField("email", e.target.value)}
          />
          {this.errors.email && <span class="error">{this.errors.email}</span>}
        </div>
        
        <div>
          <label>Message:</label>
          <textarea
            value={this.formData.message}
            oninput={(e) => this.updateField("message", e.target.value)}
            rows="4"
          />
          {this.errors.message && <span class="error">{this.errors.message}</span>}
        </div>
        
        <button type="submit">Send</button>
      </form>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("contact-form", ContactForm);
```

### Render Suspension (Performance Optimization)

```jsx
class DataTable extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.renderingSuspended = false;
    this.data = [];
    this.sortColumn = "name";
    this.sortOrder = "asc";
  }

  __webjsx_suspendRendering() {
    this.renderingSuspended = true;
  }

  __webjsx_resumeRendering() {
    this.renderingSuspended = false;
    this.render();
  }

  setData(data) {
    this.data = data;
    if (!this.renderingSuspended) {
      this.render();
    }
  }

  sort(column) {
    if (this.sortColumn === column) {
      this.sortOrder = this.sortOrder === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
    } else {
      this.sortColumn = column;
      this.sortOrder = "asc";
    }
    
    this.data.sort((a, b) => {
      const aVal = a[column];
      const bVal = b[column];
      const result = aVal < bVal ? -1 : aVal > bVal ? 1 : 0;
      return this.sortOrder === "asc" ? result : -result;
    });
    
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    if (this.renderingSuspended) return;

    const vdom = (
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th onclick={() => this.sort("name")}>
              Name {this.sortColumn === "name" && (this.sortOrder === "asc" ? "↑" : "↓")}
            </th>
            <th onclick={() => this.sort("age")}>
              Age {this.sortColumn === "age" && (this.sortOrder === "asc" ? "↑" : "↓")}
            </th>
            <th onclick={() => this.sort("city")}>
              City {this.sortColumn === "city" && (this.sortOrder === "asc" ? "↑" : "↓")}
            </th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {this.data.map((row, i) => (
            <tr key={row.id || i}>
              <td>{row.name}</td>
              <td>{row.age}</td>
              <td>{row.city}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("data-table", DataTable);
```

## Routing with webjsx-router

### Basic Router Setup

```jsx
import * as webjsx from "webjsx";
import { initRouter, match, goto } from "webjsx-router";

// Define your components
class HomePage extends HTMLElement {
  connectedCallback() {
    const vdom = (
      <div>
        <h1>Welcome to My App</h1>
        <nav>
          <button onclick={() => goto("/about")}>About</button>
          <button onclick={() => goto("/users")}>Users</button>
          <button onclick={() => goto("/contact")}>Contact</button>
        </nav>
      </div>
    );
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

class AboutPage extends HTMLElement {
  connectedCallback() {
    const vdom = (
      <div>
        <h1>About Us</h1>
        <p>This is the about page.</p>
        <button onclick={() => goto("/")}>Back to Home</button>
      </div>
    );
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

// Register components
customElements.define("home-page", HomePage);
customElements.define("about-page", AboutPage);

// Initialize router
const app = document.getElementById("app");
initRouter(app, () =>
  match("/", () => <home-page />) ||
  match("/about", () => <about-page />) ||
  match("/users", () => <user-list />) ||
  match("/contact", () => <contact-form />) ||
  <div>404 - Page not found</div>
);
```

### Dynamic Routes with Parameters

```jsx
class UserProfile extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["userid"];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.user = null;
  }

  async connectedCallback() {
    await this.loadUser();
  }

  async attributeChangedCallback() {
    await this.loadUser();
  }

  async loadUser() {
    const userId = this.getAttribute("userid");
    if (!userId) return;
    
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`);
      this.user = await response.json();
      this.render();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to load user:", err);
      this.render();
    }
  }

  render() {
    const vdom = this.user ? (
      <div>
        <h1>{this.user.name}</h1>
        <p>Email: {this.user.email}</p>
        <p>Bio: {this.user.bio}</p>
        <button onclick={() => goto("/users")}>Back to Users</button>
      </div>
    ) : (
      <div>Loading user...</div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("user-profile", UserProfile);

// Router with parameters
initRouter(app, () =>
  match("/", () => <home-page />) ||
  match("/users", () => <user-list />) ||
  match("/users/:id", (params) => <user-profile userid={params.id} />) ||
  match("/posts/:postId/comments/:commentId", (params) => (
    <comment-detail postid={params.postId} commentid={params.commentId} />
  )) ||
  <not-found />
);
```

### Query Parameters

```jsx
class SearchResults extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["query", "category", "sort"];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.results = [];
  }

  async connectedCallback() {
    await this.performSearch();
  }

  async attributeChangedCallback() {
    await this.performSearch();
  }

  async performSearch() {
    const query = this.getAttribute("query") || "";
    const category = this.getAttribute("category") || "all";
    const sort = this.getAttribute("sort") || "relevance";
    
    if (!query) {
      this.results = [];
      this.render();
      return;
    }
    
    // Simulate API call
    this.results = [
      { id: 1, title: `Result for "${query}" in ${category}`, score: 95 },
      { id: 2, title: `Another match for "${query}"`, score: 87 }
    ];
    
    if (sort === "score") {
      this.results.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    }
    
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const query = this.getAttribute("query") || "";
    const category = this.getAttribute("category") || "all";
    
    const vdom = (
      <div>
        <h1>Search Results</h1>
        <p>Searching for: "{query}" in {category}</p>
        
        <div class="filters">
          <button onclick={() => goto("/search", { 
            q: query, 
            category: "posts" 
          })}>
            Posts Only
          </button>
          <button onclick={() => goto("/search", { 
            q: query, 
            category: "users" 
          })}>
            Users Only
          </button>
          <button onclick={() => goto("/search", { 
            q: query, 
            sort: "score" 
          })}>
            Sort by Score
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <ul>
          {this.results.map(result => (
            <li key={result.id}>
              {result.title} (score: {result.score})
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

customElements.define("search-results", SearchResults);

// Router with query params
initRouter(app, () =>
  match("/search", (params, query) => (
    <search-results 
      query={query.q} 
      category={query.category}
      sort={query.sort}
    />
  )) ||
  <home-page />
);
```

### Navigation Guards and Redirects

```jsx
class ProtectedRoute extends HTMLElement {
  connectedCallback() {
    // Check authentication
    const isAuthenticated = localStorage.getItem("auth_token");
    
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      // Redirect to login
      goto("/login", { redirect: window.location.pathname });
      return;
    }
    
    // Render protected content
    const vdom = (
      <div>
        <h1>Protected Content</h1>
        <p>You can only see this if logged in.</p>
        <button onclick={() => {
          localStorage.removeItem("auth_token");
          goto("/");
        }}>
          Logout
        </button>
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

class LoginPage extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["redirect"];
  }

  handleLogin(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    // Simulate login
    localStorage.setItem("auth_token", "fake-token");
    
    // Redirect back or to home
    const redirect = this.getAttribute("redirect") || "/";
    goto(redirect);
  }

  render() {
    const vdom = (
      <form onsubmit={(e) => this.handleLogin(e)}>
        <h1>Login</h1>
        <input type="email" placeholder="Email" required />
        <input type="password" placeholder="Password" required />
        <button type="submit">Login</button>
      </form>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }
}

customElements.define("protected-route", ProtectedRoute);
customElements.define("login-page", LoginPage);
```

## Full Application Example

### E-commerce Product Catalog

```jsx
// Product Card Component
class ProductCard extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["product-id", "name", "price", "image"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  addToCart() {
    const event = new CustomEvent("add-to-cart", {
      detail: {
        id: this.getAttribute("product-id"),
        name: this.getAttribute("name"),
        price: parseFloat(this.getAttribute("price"))
      },
      bubbles: true
    });
    this.dispatchEvent(event);
  }

  render() {
    const id = this.getAttribute("product-id");
    const name = this.getAttribute("name");
    const price = this.getAttribute("price");
    const image = this.getAttribute("image");

    const vdom = (
      <div class="product-card">
        <img src={image} alt={name} />
        <h3>{name}</h3>
        <p class="price">${price}</p>
        <button onclick={() => this.addToCart()}>Add to Cart</button>
        <button onclick={() => goto(`/products/${id}`)}>View Details</button>
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

// Shopping Cart Component
class ShoppingCart extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.items = [];
    this.isOpen = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    // Listen for add-to-cart events
    document.addEventListener("add-to-cart", (e) => {
      this.addItem(e.detail);
    });
    
    this.render();
  }

  addItem(product) {
    const existing = this.items.find(item => item.id === product.id);
    if (existing) {
      existing.quantity++;
    } else {
      this.items.push({ ...product, quantity: 1 });
    }
    this.render();
  }

  removeItem(id) {
    this.items = this.items.filter(item => item.id !== id);
    this.render();
  }

  updateQuantity(id, quantity) {
    const item = this.items.find(item => item.id === id);
    if (item) {
      if (quantity <= 0) {
        this.removeItem(id);
      } else {
        item.quantity = quantity;
        this.render();
      }
    }
  }

  getTotal() {
    return this.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.price * item.quantity), 0);
  }

  render() {
    const itemCount = this.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
    
    const vdom = (
      <div class="shopping-cart">
        <button 
          class="cart-toggle"
          onclick={() => {
            this.isOpen = !this.isOpen;
            this.render();
          }}
        >
          Cart ({itemCount})
        </button>
        
        {this.isOpen && (
          <div class="cart-dropdown">
            <h3>Shopping Cart</h3>
            {this.items.length === 0 ? (
              <p>Your cart is empty</p>
            ) : (
              <>
                <ul>
                  {this.items.map(item => (
                    <li key={item.id}>
                      <span>{item.name}</span>
                      <div>
                        <button onclick={() => this.updateQuantity(item.id, item.quantity - 1)}>-</button>
                        <span>{item.quantity}</span>
                        <button onclick={() => this.updateQuantity(item.id, item.quantity + 1)}>+</button>
                        <span>${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}</span>
                        <button onclick={() => this.removeItem(item.id)}>×</button>
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
                <div class="cart-total">
                  Total: ${this.getTotal().toFixed(2)}
                </div>
                <button onclick={() => goto("/checkout")}>Checkout</button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

// Product List Page
class ProductList extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.products = [];
    this.loading = true;
    this.filters = {
      category: "all",
      minPrice: 0,
      maxPrice: 1000,
      sortBy: "name"
    };
  }

  async connectedCallback() {
    await this.loadProducts();
  }

  async loadProducts() {
    this.loading = true;
    this.render();
    
    // Simulate API call
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.products = [
        { id: 1, name: "Laptop", price: 999, category: "electronics", image: "/laptop.jpg" },
        { id: 2, name: "Phone", price: 699, category: "electronics", image: "/phone.jpg" },
        { id: 3, name: "Headphones", price: 199, category: "electronics", image: "/headphones.jpg" },
        { id: 4, name: "T-Shirt", price: 29, category: "clothing", image: "/tshirt.jpg" },
        { id: 5, name: "Jeans", price: 79, category: "clothing", image: "/jeans.jpg" }
      ];
      this.loading = false;
      this.render();
    }, 1000);
  }

  applyFilters() {
    let filtered = [...this.products];
    
    // Category filter
    if (this.filters.category !== "all") {
      filtered = filtered.filter(p => p.category === this.filters.category);
    }
    
    // Price filter
    filtered = filtered.filter(p => 
      p.price >= this.filters.minPrice && 
      p.price <= this.filters.maxPrice
    );
    
    // Sort
    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      switch(this.filters.sortBy) {
        case "price-asc":
          return a.price - b.price;
        case "price-desc":
          return b.price - a.price;
        case "name":
        default:
          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
      }
    });
    
    return filtered;
  }

  updateFilter(filterName, value) {
    this.filters[filterName] = value;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    if (this.loading) {
      const vdom = <div class="loading">Loading products...</div>;
      webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
      return;
    }

    const filteredProducts = this.applyFilters();

    const vdom = (
      <div class="product-list-page">
        <h1>Products</h1>
        
        <div class="filters">
          <select onchange={(e) => this.updateFilter("category", e.target.value)}>
            <option value="all">All Categories</option>
            <option value="electronics">Electronics</option>
            <option value="clothing">Clothing</option>
          </select>
          
          <select onchange={(e) => this.updateFilter("sortBy", e.target.value)}>
            <option value="name">Sort by Name</option>
            <option value="price-asc">Price: Low to High</option>
            <option value="price-desc">Price: High to Low</option>
          </select>
          
          <label>
            Max Price: ${this.filters.maxPrice}
            <input 
              type="range" 
              min="0" 
              max="1000" 
              value={this.filters.maxPrice}
              oninput={(e) => this.updateFilter("maxPrice", parseInt(e.target.value))}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
        
        <div class="product-grid">
          {filteredProducts.map(product => (
            <product-card
              key={product.id}
              product-id={product.id}
              name={product.name}
              price={product.price}
              image={product.image}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
        
        {filteredProducts.length === 0 && (
          <p>No products match your filters.</p>
        )}
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}

// Register all components
customElements.define("product-card", ProductCard);
customElements.define("shopping-cart", ShoppingCart);
customElements.define("product-list", ProductList);

// App Shell
class AppShell extends HTMLElement {
  connectedCallback() {
    const vdom = (
      <div class="app">
        <header>
          <h1 onclick={() => goto("/")}>My Store</h1>
          <nav>
            <button onclick={() => goto("/products")}>Products</button>
            <button onclick={() => goto("/about")}>About</button>
          </nav>
          <shopping-cart />
        </header>
        <main id="router-outlet"></main>
      </div>
    );
    
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
    
    // Initialize router in the main outlet
    const outlet = this.querySelector("#router-outlet");
    initRouter(outlet, () =>
      match("/", () => <home-page />) ||
      match("/products", () => <product-list />) ||
      match("/products/:id", (params) => <product-detail id={params.id} />) ||
      match("/checkout", () => <checkout-page />) ||
      match("/about", () => <about-page />) ||
      <not-found />
    );
  }
}

customElements.define("app-shell", AppShell);

// Mount the app
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const app = <app-shell />;
  webjsx.applyDiff(document.body, app);
});
```

## TypeScript Support

### Custom Elements Declaration

Create a `custom-elements.d.ts` file:

```typescript
import "webjsx";

declare global {
  namespace JSX {
    interface IntrinsicElements {
      "todo-item": {
        text: string;
        completed?: boolean;
      };
      "user-card": {
        name: string;
        avatar?: string;
        bio?: string;
      };
      "product-card": {
        "product-id": string | number;
        name: string;
        price: string | number;
        image: string;
      };
      "shopping-cart": {};
      "product-list": {};
      // Add all your custom elements here
    }
  }
}
```

## HTML Setup (No Bundler)

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <title>WebJSX App</title>
  <style>
    /* Your styles here */
    .product-card {
      border: 1px solid #ddd;
      padding: 1rem;
      margin: 0.5rem;
    }
  </style>
  
  <!-- Import map for modules -->
  <script type="importmap">
    {
      "imports": {
        "webjsx": "./node_modules/webjsx/dist/index.js",
        "webjsx/jsx-runtime": "./node_modules/webjsx/dist/jsx-runtime.js",
        "webjsx-router": "./node_modules/webjsx-router/dist/index.js"
      }
    }
  </script>
  
  <!-- Your compiled TypeScript/JavaScript -->
  <script type="module" src="./dist/app.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="app"></div>
</body>
</html>
```

## Performance Tips

1. **Use Keys for Dynamic Lists**: Always provide unique keys when rendering lists to optimize DOM updates
2. **Render Suspension**: Use `__webjsx_suspendRendering` and `__webjsx_resumeRendering` when updating multiple properties
3. **Event Delegation**: For large lists, consider using event delegation instead of individual handlers
4. **Lazy Loading**: Load components on demand using dynamic imports
5. **Memoization**: Cache expensive computations in component properties

## Common Patterns

### Global State Management

```jsx
// Simple event-based state store
class Store extends EventTarget {
  constructor(initialState = {}) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  update(updates) {
    this.state = { ...this.state, ...updates };
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("statechange", { 
      detail: this.state 
    }));
  }

  subscribe(component) {
    const handler = () => component.render();
    this.addEventListener("statechange", handler);
    return () => this.removeEventListener("statechange", handler);
  }
}

// Usage
const appStore = new Store({
  user: null,
  theme: "light"
});

class ThemedComponent extends HTMLElement {
  connectedCallback() {
    this.unsubscribe = appStore.subscribe(this);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.unsubscribe?.();
  }

  render() {
    const theme = appStore.state.theme;
    const vdom = (
      <div class={`themed ${theme}`}>
        <p>Current theme: {theme}</p>
        <button onclick={() => appStore.update({ 
          theme: theme === "light" ? "dark" : "light" 
        })}>
          Toggle Theme
        </button>
      </div>
    );
    webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
  }
}
```

### Component Composition

```jsx
// Higher-order component pattern
function withAuth(Component) {
  return class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      if (!isAuthenticated()) {
        goto("/login");
        return;
      }
      
      const vdom = <Component {...this.attributes} />;
      webjsx.applyDiff(this, vdom);
    }
  };
}

// Usage
const ProtectedDashboard = withAuth(Dashboard);
customElements.define("protected-dashboard", ProtectedDashboard);
```

## Debugging Tips

1. Use browser DevTools to inspect custom elements
2. Add `console.log` in render methods to track re-renders
3. Use Performance tab to profile rendering performance
4. Check for memory leaks in disconnectedCallback
5. Validate that event listeners are properly cleaned up

## Best Practices

1. **Component Design**: Keep components focused and single-purpose
2. **State Management**: Minimize component state, lift state up when needed
3. **Event Handling**: Clean up event listeners in disconnectedCallback
4. **Attribute vs Property**: Use attributes for primitive values, properties for complex data
5. **Error Boundaries**: Wrap render methods in try-catch for better error handling
6. **Testing**: Test components in isolation using jsdom or similar
7. **Accessibility**: Always include proper ARIA attributes and semantic HTML
